name: Datafast OG social card — headline + chart card by datafa.st
description: A 1200×630 social card built on a warm cream canvas with a single centred vertical stack: five golden stars, a one-line bold benefit headline, and a large white chart card that bleeds off the bottom edge. The chart does the branding work — organic, uneven coral bars with rounded tops sit under a wavy sky-blue area line, and a stat row ('5.4k visitors • $2,325 revenue') pairs bold dark numbers with gray labels. Hierarchy comes purely from scale and weight contrast on neutrals; three soft accents (coral, sky blue, gold) carry all the colour, and the off-white background makes the white card read as a floating product screenshot.
